operations.name: Theodore Kaczynski

expected.charges: 18 USC 844(d) Transporting an Explosive in Interstate Commerce With Intent to Kill or Injure [4 counts]; 18 USC 1716 Mailing an Explosive Device [3 counts]; 18 USC 924(c) Use of a Destructive Device During a Crime of Violence [3 counts] - 1978-1995 Unabomber mail-bombing campaign
expected.sentence: Four life sentences plus 30 years; no parole
